unit.why: A letter to R. Avraham Yehoshua Heschel of Apt asking his consent to print Etz Hayyim / Pri Etz Hayyim and defending the study and correct editing of the Zohar. Its brief personal circumstances (an interrupted journey, a dispute over a rival printing) serve the letter's request and argument and are not narrated as a tale.
unit.boundary_note: letter ends here; next division is an editor's note on the autograph's provenance
